result.title: Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families
result.summary: LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text. This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only data. SwaT keeps both sender and receiver models frozen without fine-tuning and only requires $<50M$ tokens and $<1$ GPU-day to train.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SwaT，用跨模型家族的 KV-cache 传输替代文本通信，使接收方无需重新 prefill 即可获得发送方的上下文状态，并演示由 VLM 发送方向纯文本 LLM 迁移视觉能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 以 KV 状态而非离散 token 作为 agent 间信息通道，与 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的传递、视觉信息能否保留在内部表示并绕过文本旁路的问题相关，可供核查；但该工作面向通信带宽与速度，未研究视觉推理机制本身。
